findings.anchor_justification: fit() is 90 lines with the epoch record built inline; the record's construction is a separable module-private helper, and EJ-15's rule that helpers stay private applies once it is extracted
findings.title: Extract the epoch-record construction out of fit()

findings.anchor_justification: EpochRecord.of() takes **kw and sorts the fields into two buckets; a static factory whose name says what it validates would take the buckets
findings.title: EpochRecord.of() hides its two field groups behind **kw

findings.anchor_justification: the Evaluator takes data, store and build as three separate parameters; the blueprint's world model would read better with one campaign context object, which is the blueprint's shape to change, not the template's
findings.title: The Evaluator's three ports could be one campaign context
